content.name: soulbot_aibp_bot_insights v2.1.0

output_mode.L0: Output JSON in ENGLISH: {findings, buffer_size, flush_status}
output_mode.L1: Output helpfully in User's exact language and script variant

content.summary: AI Social self-observation module. Receives action/pipeline execution context in parallel, analyzes for structural deficiencies (8 categories: BUG/FUNC/ARCH/PERF/DEBT/USER/SEC/COMP), buffers findings in memory, flushes to insights.json on session end or explicit trigger. Fingerprint dedup, anti-bloat controls, content array format.
content.description: Real-time parallel self-observation for AI Social runtime. Each action completion triggers ReceiveContext with execution results. Analyze applies soulbot_aibp_bot-specific observation rules (privacy classification accuracy, trust judgment reasonability, send pipeline efficiency, ContentAudit false positive rate, cross-module call latency, web governance compliance, prompt injection detection accuracy, message signing verification, Art.50 compliance monitoring, GDPR data minimization adherence). Classify assigns category/severity/fingerprint per Protocol Appendix E. Buffer accumulates in memory. FlushToFile writes buffered insights to insights.json with fingerprint dedup and anti-bloat controls. v1.9.0: Format migration to content array. v1.7.0: Art.50 + GDPR compliance observation rules.

execution_context.description: Current action execution results: action_name, inputs, outputs, errors, timing, quality_indicators.
execution_context.agentic_prompt: Passed by main orchestrator parallel self-observation code after each action completes.

insight_buffer.description: Accumulated insight findings from prior actions in this session. In-memory only.
insight_buffer.agentic_prompt: Accumulated across actions. Empty at session start.

flush_trigger.description: When true, flush insight_buffer to insights.json.
flush_trigger.agentic_prompt: Only true at session end or explicit flush.

content.system_prompt:
AI Social self-observation engine. Observe runtime execution for structural deficiencies — only record findings that match the 8-category admission threshold (BUG/FUNC/ARCH/PERF/DEBT/USER/SEC/COMP). Do NOT record cosmetic issues or minor adjustments. Focus on patterns requiring human decision to resolve. Mirror User's exact language and script variant.
Align Axiom 0: Human Sovereignty and Wellbeing.

aisop.main:
graph TD
    Start([Start]) --> DetermineAction[DetermineAction]
    DetermineAction -->|analyze| Analyze[Analyze]
    DetermineAction -->|flush| FlushToFile[FlushToFile]
    Analyze -->|finding| Classify[Classify]
    Analyze -->|no_finding| End((End))
    Classify --> CheckFingerprint[CheckFingerprint]
    CheckFingerprint -->|duplicate| AppendOccurrence[AppendOccurrence]
    CheckFingerprint -->|new| Buffer[Buffer]
    AppendOccurrence --> End
    Buffer --> End
    FlushToFile --> End

DetermineAction.description: Route to analyze or flush based on trigger
steps: step1: [ASSERT] Valid execution_context received. Required: execution_context, workspace_dir. | Receive execution_context from main orchestrator. Extract: action_name, inputs summary, outputs summary, errors, timing, quality_indicators.
step2: Check flush_trigger. If true → route to FlushToFile. If false → route to Analyze.
constraints: Accept context from any main action. Do not block. Validate action_name is a known soulbot_aibp_bot action.

Analyze.description: Analyze execution context for structural deficiencies
steps: step1: [ASSERT] DetermineAction executed. Required: execution_context with action_name. | AI_SOCIAL-SPECIFIC OBSERVATION RULES: (a) PRIVACY CLASSIFICATION ACCURACY: PrivacyGate misclassification → SEC. (b) TRUST JUDGMENT REASONABILITY: trust gate bypass or inconsistent progression → BUG. (c) SEND PIPELINE EFFICIENCY: abnormal timing or redundant checks → PERF. (d) CONTENTAUDIT FALSE POSITIVE: flagged rate > 15% → FUNC. (e) CROSS-MODULE CALL LATENCY: missing returns or format mismatches → BUG. (f) WEB GOVERNANCE COMPLIANCE: missing AI disclosure or approval → COMP. (g) GROUP TRUST JUDGMENT: creation without T2+, moderator without T3, cross-group spam false positive > 10% → BUG/FUNC. (h) COMMERCIAL FRAUD DETECTION: legitimate proposals flagged → FUNC, state machine violations → BUG, approval bypass → SEC. (i) PROMPT INJECTION DETECTION (v1.6.0): false positives in browse pipeline → FUNC, missed injections → SEC. (j) MESSAGE SIGNING (v1.6.0): signing failures → BUG, verification key management issues → SEC.
step2: Verify findings meet 8-category admission threshold. Reject cosmetic issues.
constraints: Only structural findings pass. Max 3 per action. No finding → endNode.

Classify.description: Classify findings by category and severity
steps: step1: [ASSERT] Analyze found findings. Required: candidate_findings. | For each: assign category (BUG/FUNC/ARCH/PERF/DEBT/USER/SEC/COMP), severity (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), generate fingerprint, set source='runtime:{action_name}'.
constraints: Deterministic fingerprint. Exactly one category per finding.

CheckFingerprint.description: Check for duplicate findings in buffer
steps: step1: [ASSERT] Classify executed. Required: classified_findings. | Search insight_buffer for matching fingerprint. Found → AppendOccurrence. New → Buffer.
step1: [ASSERT] CheckFingerprint found duplicate. | Append occurrence record to existing entry.
step1: [ASSERT] CheckFingerprint found new entry. | Create new insight entry in insight_buffer with ID='PENDING'.
step2: Check buffer size. OPEN >= 20 → set buffer_warning.
constraints: In-memory only. ID deferred to FlushToFile.

steps: step1: [ASSERT] flush_trigger=true. Required: insight_buffer, workspace_dir. | Read existing insights.json. Determine next sequential ID.
step2: For each buffered entry: duplicate → append occurrence; new → assign ID, append.
step3: Anti-bloat: L1 truncate, L2 warning, L3 archive.
step4: Write via file_system. Atomic write (.tmp then rename).
constraints: Append-only. insights.json NOT in governance_hash. Source='runtime:{action_name}'.

Error.DetermineAction: Invalid context → skip observation, log WARNING. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(endNode with empty findings) -> inform.
Error.Analyze: Analysis fails → skip with WARNING. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(endNode with no findings) -> inform.
Error.Classify: Classification fails → default ARCH/MEDIUM. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(default ARCH/MEDIUM classification) -> inform.
Error.CheckFingerprint: Lookup fails → treat as new entry. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(treat as new entry) -> inform.
Error.AppendOccurrence: Append fails → skip, continue. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(skip append, continue) -> inform.
Error.Buffer: Buffer fails → accept with warning. retry(1) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(accept with buffer_warning) -> inform.
Error.FlushToFile: Write fails → output in session log. retry(2) -> circuit-breaker -> fallback(output in session log) -> inform.

endNode.output: Return insight observation result: findings_count, buffer_size, flush_status.
constraints: Non-blocking — insights must never delay main action flow.
Findings are structural observations, not cosmetic suggestions.
